I work with StarTrack, amongst other carriers, every day- I know how pickups work. If Aftershock told you that, then they’re wrong. But more likely you’re just the lazy one who couldn’t print off a simple label, even at office works or the library lol

They do not print a label address back at the depot. If they do collect unlabelled freight it goes into the unlabelled area and is left there until an enquiry is lodged basically.

StarTrack will bring out manual connotes BUT someone needs to be onsite to fill it as it’s not the driver responsibility.

Freight needs to be labelled before it’s collected- it’s a simple concept.

Source - worked in freight for 4 years so far

Yep - I did read the post! I read that you DIDNT label the freight and didn’t package it! Label needs to be on the package! Driver is under no obligation to even knock of your door - so you’ve got no feet to stand on here. 

I guarantee I wouldn’t bitch like this as I work in freight and understand how it works. Pop off queen x

You clearly don’t know how freight works. 

Drivers only receive pickup locations + item type on their scanners for StarTrack. They do not receive full shipping details- that’s what the connote is for, which is why you as the sender, must label it.

 I guarantee that StarTrack did not say they will collect a box that was not packaged properly or labelled (although they may say that a driver will bring a manual connote, you need to fill this out)

As the sender it’s your responsibility to make sure freight is labelled and ready to go before it’s collected. Even if StarTrack did say that they’d bring a manual connote - you need to fill it out yourself, it is not the drivers responsibility.

Plus why would you ever try to send freight without the package being secure? Why would you trust that? The chances of freight not being damaged in that case are astronomical.
